messages:
olivia: 🎉 Quick shout — finance just confirmed we closed $88M ARR for the year. Tiny victory lap? :tada:
mike: OMG yes!!! Rooftop + kombucha? :keg: :raised_hands:
sage: count me in. I can make a mini playlist (synth + bossa). also high five to @olivia for the spreadsheet heroics. :sparkles:
noah: can we do a low-sugar dessert option? my dentist will thank you. :grimacing:
zara: poll: what should we bring? react to this message with your pick — :cake: cake, :cup_with_straw: kombucha, :plant: succulents for the winners, :kazoo: tiny kazoos for moral support
mike: I will bring two cakes (one GF). putting a post-it on the fridge so people can grab later. :cake:
olivia: optional mini ceremony at 4:15 in the kitchenette — 2 min thank-you, 1 minute kazoo solo, then snacks. @here if you want to say a quick line pls hop on a sticky note on the board.
noah: can we also do a virtual option for folks remote? zoom link pls so my cat can attend. :cat2:
sage: love to see the remote + in-person combo. I'll add a slide that says "we shipped" with a confetti GIF.
plant-bot: Friendly reminder: please recycle cake boxes. :recycle: Also free plant stickers in the kitchen drawer.
zara: kudos thread: who deserves a shoutout? i nominate @mike for cake logistics and @olivia for leading the deal close.
mike: thank you! huge props to engineering for keeping latency down during the spike — you all rock. :guitar:
olivia: big team effort. tiny non-work anecdote: first cup of coffee i drank while staring at the ARR dashboard had glitter from the confetti dispenser. 10/10 would recommend. :coffee: :sparkles:
noah: RSVP: me (remote), will bring a terribly played kazoo solo.
sage: RSVP: in person, playlist ready. also I'm bringing lemon bars.
zara: RSVP: in person, plant stickers at the ready.
mike: RSVP: in person, two cakes, one gf.
olivia: thanks everyone — see you at 4:15. taking a quick screenshot for the all-hands slide deck. :camera_flash: :tada:
